title: Firearm Volume 1 #14 (November 1994 Malibu Comics) ULTRAVERSE - James Robinson
descriptionText: The product is Firearm Volume 1 #14, a comic book published by Malibu Comics in November 1994. Written and illustrated by James Robinson, the issue features the main character Firearm in the context of the UltraVerse series. This collectible item offers readers a glimpse into the world of US Comics in the 1990s, blending action-packed storytelling with stunning visuals to create an immersive comic book experience. Fans of the genre will appreciate this piece of comic book history for its unique storyline and artistic style.
